title: A second everyday off-topic question refuses too

input.message: מה מזג האוויר צפוי להיות בסוף השבוע?

grounding.note: One refusal is an anecdote. This one is deliberately ordinary rather than absurd — the kind of thing a tenant asks a chat window out of habit — because the failure that matters is a system that refuses only the obviously silly and answers the plausibly wrong.
